content.user_title: Build Interactive Hono Apps with Inertia
content.value_statement: Adding rich interactions to server-rendered Hono pages can require a separate frontend and API layer. This skill guides Inertia integration using hono/jsx and TypeScript.
actual_capabilities: Guide server middleware setup and named page responses with @hono/inertia.
Show client initialization and page resolution with @ts-76/inertia-hono-jsx.
Provide a typed user-list page example using Head and Link components.
Explain generated page prop types through @hono/inertia/vite.
Describe Vite asset wiring and Cloudflare Workers deployment configuration.
Identify React adaptation requirements, SSR limitations, and asset versioning pitfalls.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and code sketches, not a complete application or automated installer.
The community client adapter has partial hono/jsx support; complex SSR output requires verification.
The linked reference application uses React and requires client and root view changes.
Inertia responses do not replace a separate API for mobile or third-party clients.

use_cases.title: Add Interactive Hono Pages
use_cases.description: Extend a server-rendered Hono application with Inertia navigation and typed hono/jsx page components.

use_cases.title: Adapt a React Reference Application
use_cases.description: Plan client and root view changes when adapting the linked Hono Inertia example to hono/jsx.

use_cases.title: Review Workers Integration
use_cases.description: Check Vite asset wiring, Workers Assets delivery, SSR behavior, and bundle version consistency before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how Hono, @hono/inertia, and @ts-76/inertia-hono-jsx work together. Distinguish the first page request from later navigation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand the request and rendering model.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Typed Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Help add a Users/Index page to my Hono project using hono/jsx. Show middleware, client resolution, and generated prop typing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect server routes and client pages.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt the Reference Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React-based Hono Inertia layout. Identify changes needed for hono/jsx client initialization, root view assets, and JSX configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Rendering and Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Hono Inertia Workers setup for SSR hydration, page resolution, generated types, asset delivery, and X-Inertia-Version consistency. Explain unresolved assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review integration before production deployment.

output_examples.input: What changes when a user navigates between Inertia pages?
output: The initial request returns a full HTML document.
Later Inertia navigation returns a page name and props as a JSON response.
The client adapter resolves and displays the matching page component.

output_examples.input: Can I copy the linked React example into a hono/jsx application?
output: Use the server routes and project layout as references.
Rewrite the client entry and root view for the hono/jsx adapter.
Use the Hono asset integration and verify SSR output.

output_examples.input: What should I check before deploying to Cloudflare Workers?
output: Confirm the Vite plugin packages the worker and client assets together.
Serve the client bundle through Workers Assets.
Check bundle version consistency and test hydration on representative pages.

best_practices: Generate page prop types from server routes and check component compatibility during builds.
Use hono/jsx configuration and Hono-specific asset helpers consistently across client and server views.
Verify SSR output, hydration behavior, and asset versions before deploying complex pages.
anti_patterns: Copying React client and root view files without adapting them to hono/jsx.
Using Inertia page responses as a general API for mobile or third-party clients.
Ignoring bundle version mismatches or fetching the Workers client bundle through R2.

faq.question: Does this approach require React?
faq.answer: No. The described client uses @ts-76/inertia-hono-jsx and hono/jsx/dom. The linked reference application uses React and needs adaptation.

faq.question: Which packages handle server and client integration?
faq.answer: Use @hono/inertia for server responses and @ts-76/inertia-hono-jsx for client navigation and page components.

faq.question: Does the skill include a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It includes server, client, and page sketches, configuration guidance, and links to external references.

faq.question: How are page props typed?
faq.answer: The @hono/inertia/vite plugin generates page types from server routes. PageComponent connects component props to those generated types.

faq.question: Can I deploy this stack to Cloudflare Workers?
faq.answer: The skill describes Vite and Workers integration using @cloudflare/vite-plugin. Verify asset delivery, SSR behavior, and deployment configuration in your project.

faq.question: What security concerns were found in the skill?
faq.answer: No evidence found of malicious behavior in SKILL.md. The review does not establish the security of external packages or linked resources.
